title: Grab and Move doesn't reliably decrease window size

judgment.rationale: The gesture and affected applications are specified and the current resize path has an identifiable state transition, but no current reproduction establishes the faulty branch.
evidence: On 0.99.1 repeated fast Alt-right-drag changes to Firefox, cmd.exe and What's New can create an increasing apparent minimum width.
The report includes a repeatable gesture and identifies Windows 11 25H2.

HandleDragResize recalculates the closest resize handle while moving, applies deltas to the current rectangle, and enforces a fixed minimum: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/GrabAndMove/GrabAndMove/main.cpp.

fix_assessment.rationale: The gesture and affected applications are specified and the current resize path has an identifiable state transition, but no current reproduction establishes the faulty branch.

proposed_fixes.title: Prevent accumulating resize bounds during rapid reversals
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Re-selecting the closest edge during one drag or divergence between requested and actual rectangles could accumulate apparent minimum size; neither is proven.
plan: Reproduce rapid alternating horizontal movement in the three reported windows.
Compare selected handle, pointer deltas, requested rectangle and actual window bounds to locate any accumulating error.
Fix the verified edge-selection or rectangle synchronization defect and add an alternating-drag regression including applications with their own minimum sizes.
verification: Repeated horizontal drags can shrink back to the application's actual minimum without progressively increasing it; normal edge and corner resize still works.

confidence.rationale: The gesture and affected applications are specified and the current resize path has an identifiable state transition, but no current reproduction establishes the faulty branch.

reproduce.title: Rapidly reverse a window resize
setup: Enable Alt modifier and right-button resize.
steps: Start resizing one of the reported windows.
Keep the button down and rapidly move the pointer left and right repeatedly.
Try to shrink the window back to its starting size.
reproduce.expected_result: Width follows the gesture and can return to the application's genuine minimum.
